# Test fixtures

Everything below this directory is synthetic, deterministic test or demonstration data. It is
never presented as live GitHub, Neo4j, retrieval, browser or model evidence.

```text
fixtures/
├── configs/       Offline coordinator configurations
├── coordinator/   Saved tool results and model decisions
└── requests/      Inputs used only by offline fixture runs
```

Real runnable request examples remain under `examples/requests/`. Production coordinator,
application and provider settings remain under `configs/`.
